description: This file defines models and methods for managing analytic plans, plan lines, plan instances, and their integration with accounting and sales modules in an OpenERP/Odoo environment. It includes class definitions, method overrides, and view customizations related to analytic distributions.

classes.name: one2many_mod2
classes.description: Custom one2many field with specialized get method for analytic plans

classes.name: account_analytic_plan
classes.description: Model representing analytic plans with plan lines

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_line
classes.description: Model representing individual lines within an analytic plan

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_instance
classes.description: Model for instances of analytic plans, including distribution details and view customization

classes.name: account_analytic_plan_instance_line
classes.description: Lines within an analytic plan instance, linking to analytic accounts with rates

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Extension adding plan_id to account journal

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension adding analytics_id to invoice lines and methods for handling analytic info

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Extension adding analytics_id to move lines and methods for creating analytic lines

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension to handle analytic lines in invoices

classes.name: analytic_default
classes.description: Extension adding analytics_id to default analytic settings

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extension to set analytic account on invoice creation from sales order lines
